exercises.title: Read a text file: lines, words, characters, the longest line
concepts: readLine() returns null at the end
exercises.problemHtml:
Read the file input.txt from the current folder and print:

lines: 4
words: 11
characters: 52
longest line: #2 (21 characters)
  • characters = the characters of every line, line breaks not counted; words = tokens separated by whitespace;
  • longest line: the first one on a tie; an empty file → lines: 0, words: 0, characters: 0, longest line: none;
  • when the file does not exist print only cannot open input.txt — no stack trace.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 4 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Use try-with-resources so the file is always closed.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:

exercises.title: Write a report file in UTF-8, then read it back
exercises.problemHtml:
Read lines name;mark from the keyboard and write report.txt in UTF-8:

REPORT (3 students)
1. An        8.50 PASS
2. Binh      4.00 FAIL
3. Chi      10.00 PASS
average: 7.50

Rows: String.format("%d. %-8s %5.2f %s", …), PASS when mark ≥ 5. Skip an invalid line (not two parts, mark not a number or outside 0..10) and count it: after the average add skipped: 1 (only when something was skipped). With no valid student write REPORT (0 students) and average: 0.00.

Then close the writer, open report.txt again and print it to the screen, followed by -- report.txt: 5 lines.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 4 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Write with an explicit UTF-8 charset (not the platform default).
  • Print the file only after it has been closed.

exercises.title: CSV to objects: skip broken lines and say why
exercises.problemHtml:
books.csv (UTF-8) has a header code,title,year,copies and one book per line. Load every valid line into a List<Book> and report each broken one with its line number (the header is line 1):

line 4 skipped: expected 4 fields, found 3
line 6 skipped: year is not a number: 20O5
line 7 skipped: copies must be >= 0: -2
loaded 3 books, skipped 3 lines (blank lines ignored)

Blank lines are ignored silently (not counted). Then print the books sorted by year, then code: B002 Effective Java 2018 x2. A missing file → cannot open books.csv.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 4 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Book.java is given.
  • One try/catch per line: a broken line never stops the loading.

exercises.title: A log that survives a restart: append mode
exercises.problemHtml:
The program is run twice in the same folder (the grader restarts it). Each run:

  1. reads visits.log if it exists and prints previous visits: 3 (0 when the file is missing);
  2. reads member ids from the keyboard and appends one line per valid id (M + 3 digits, stored upper-case) to visits.log — an invalid id prints ignored: <id>;
  3. prints this run: 2, total: 5 and the last 3 lines of the log: last: M001, M002, M007.

Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Open the writer in append mode — never rewrite the whole file.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Chương trình được chạy hai lần trong cùng thư mục (máy chấm mở lại nó). Mỗi lần: đọc visits.log nếu có và in previous visits: 3 (0 khi chưa có tệp); đọc mã thành viên từ bàn phím và ghi nối mỗi mã hợp lệ (M + 3 chữ số, lưu viết hoa) thành một dòng vào visits.log — mã sai in ignored: <mã>; in this run: 2, total: 5 và 3 dòng cuối của nhật ký: last: M001, M002, M007.

Chạy máy chấm trên máy bạn

Website KHÔNG chấm bài này. Bấm Tải .zip ở khung code, giải nén, sửa code trong src/, rồi trong thư mục bài (thư mục chứa cham.mjs) chạy:

node cham.mjs

Giải nén ra một thư mục mang tên bài (gọi là <thư-mục>). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<thư-mục>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<thư-mục> — rồi node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<thư-mục> rồi node cham.mjs. Mẹo: gõ cd rồi kéo thư mục vào cửa sổ terminal. Cần Node.js 18+ và JDK 8 trở lên (khuyên 17 hoặc 21) — javac -version phải chạy được.

Máy chấm biên dịch src/ bằng javac, chạy 3 ca (2 ca ẩn — không in trong đề), so output từng dòng (bỏ qua khoảng trắng cuối dòng và kiểu xuống dòng Windows/macOS), in diff dòng sai, soát luật mã nguồn rồi cho điểm. In ALL CHECKS PASSED ⇒ quay lại đây bấm Tự đánh dấu đã giải. node cham.mjs --case 2 --show in input và toàn bộ output của bạn cho ca 2.

Yêu cầu

  • Mở writer ở chế độ ghi nối — không viết lại cả tệp.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: Data that must outlive the program goes to a file: read it on start-up, append new records as they arrive. Append mode adds to the end instead of truncating, which is what makes the second run see the first one’s visits.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Dữ liệu phải sống lâu hơn chương trình thì ghi ra tệp: đọc lúc khởi động, ghi nối bản ghi mới khi có. Chế độ nối thêm vào cuối thay vì cắt bỏ — đó là điều giúp lần chạy thứ hai thấy lượt ghé của lần đầu.

mistakesJson.loi: new FileWriter(LOG) without true — session 2 reports "previous visits: 2" but the log ends up with only its own lines.|||new FileWriter(LOG) thiếu true — lần 2 báo "previous visits: 2" nhưng nhật ký chỉ còn các dòng của nó.
Opening the writer BEFORE reading the old log, in overwrite mode — the old content is gone before it is read.|||Mở writer ghi đè TRƯỚC khi đọc nhật ký cũ — nội dung cũ mất trước khi kịp đọc.
